issues.legal_issue: A participant in a sub-partnership may be denied an equitable share of a successful recovery for laches when the participant remains inactive while another bears the work and litigation expenses, then claims a share after the recovery is obtained.
material_facts: The claimant was promised a share in another participant’s interest in a forest-working partnership.
The other participant was excluded from the underlying partnership’s benefits and had to bring litigation to establish and recover his entitlement.
The claimant did not contribute to that litigation’s expenses, apart from a small initial payment, and did not assist in pursuing the claim.
The claimant’s father, who was the moving force behind the sub-partnership arrangement, testified in the underlying litigation that he knew nothing of the underlying partnership.
After the other participant obtained a substantial recovery, the claimant sued for a share of it.
issues.conclusion: The claimant was precluded by laches from obtaining a share of the recovery. The decree granting that share was set aside, and the dismissal of the claim was restored.
issues.legal_principle: Lindley on Partnership, 12th edition, states that laches requires both lapse of time and circumstances making relief unjust; a claimant seeking equitable relief must show reasonable vigilance. In a partnership or joint venture, equity will not assist someone who leaves another to do the work and bear the risks, remains quiet while the outcome is uncertain, and claims a share only when the venture succeeds. The Court applied the maxim vigilanti-bus non dormientibus subveniunt leges: the law assists the vigilant, not those who sleep on their rights.

rule.if: appeal_from_share_decree and claimant_remained_inactive_during_underlying_litigation and claimant_did_not_fund_litigation and other_participant_bore_litigation_burden and claimant_claimed_share_after_success

predicates.appeal_from_share_decree: An appeal challenged a decree granting a claimant a share of a recovery obtained through another participant’s litigation.
predicates.claimant_remained_inactive_during_underl: The claimant remained inactive while the other participant pursued the underlying claim.
predicates.claimant_did_not_fund_litigation: The claimant did not contribute materially to the expenses of the underlying litigation.
predicates.other_participant_bore_litigation_burden: The other participant pursued the litigation and bore its burdens without the claimant’s assistance.
predicates.claimant_claimed_share_after_success: The claimant sought a share only after the underlying litigation produced a recovery.
predicates.equitable_share_claim_denied: The claimant is denied an equitable share of the recovery.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns a decree granting a share of a recovery, and the claimant remained inactive and did not fund the litigation that another participant pursued, claiming a share only after success, the equitable share claim is denied.
